overview_description.description:
Upside (formerly GetUpside) is a U.S.-based marketplace for in-person purchases at gas stations, grocery stores, and restaurants. Its two-sided platform connects consumers looking to earn cash back on everyday purchases with businesses looking to grow by attracting new customers and driving repeat visits. 

Consumers earn cash back that they can easily cash out to a bank account or their choice of gift cards at any time. Retailers pay only for proven incremental transactions, not for impressions or clicks. The app is free to download with no subscription required. To date, consumers have earned over $1 billion in cash back and retailers have earned $3 billion in incremental profit.

product.name: Upside Cashback App
product.description: A mobile application that offers users cash back rewards on purchases at gas stations, grocery stores, and restaurants by claiming offers and paying with linked credit or debit cards.

product.name: Upside Digital Marketplace Platform
product.description: A platform that connects retailers and consumers by delivering personalized, retailer-funded promotions to drive incremental, attributable profit in physical stores.

product.name: Upside Pay
product.description: A mobile payment feature within the Upside app that allows users to pay at participating merchants by scanning a barcode or QR code to earn cash back rewards.

product.name: Upside Referral Program
product.description: A program that allows users to earn additional cash back rewards by referring friends and acquaintances who join Upside and make qualifying purchases.

product.name: Upside Retailer Dashboard
product.description: An online dashboard that provides retailers with detailed insights into program performance, including incremental sales, profit, and customer segmentation.

product.name: Upside Co-Marketing Partnerships
product.description: A service that enables businesses to partner with Upside to deliver personalized, retailer-funded offers to their customers, enhancing user engagement and conversion.
